name: Phantom Satellite
description:
Phantom Satellite is a web browser forked from Pale Moon that focuses on supporting legacy, specialized, and niche Linux operating systems while maintaining modern web compatibility.

Features:
- Optimized Goanna layout engine with minimal runtime library dependencies
- Built to run seamlessly on older Linux distributions and non-standard architectures
- Support for classic XUL and UXP extensions and browser themes
- Built-in privacy controls blocking third-party tracking and telemetry
- Familiar traditional browser interface with customizable toolbars and menus
